parameters.description_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a token from your client to make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each request is unique.

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
